prompt:
A reviewer found these problems in your research questions and plan. Fix each one. Answer with JSON: researchQuestions, plan and candidate, whole.
1. Phase 2 –

content.text:
The reviewer wants me to fix the headspace oxygen measurement issue. I need to name explicitly which party supplies or hires a headspace oxygen analyser in the plan. Since neither side has one listed, I should note it needs to be hired/procured and name it explicitly in the relevant phase.

Let me adjust Phase 2 to explicitly state that a headspace oxygen analyser will be hired for the bottling-line measurement, and attribute responsibility to one party. The term sheet says the company provides "Access to production line for headspace oxygen measurement" but doesn't name an instrument. The university leads the analysis work. I'll say the university will hire a portable headspace oxygen analyser for the bottling-line visit.
